sources.title: Conformer LLMs - Convolution Augmented Large Language Models
sources.snippet: Abstract This work builds together two popular blocks of neural architecture, namely convolutional layers and Transformers, for large language models (LLMs). Non-causal conformers are used ubiquitously in automatic speech recognition.
